source: Later work simplified or replaced these objectives. Switch uses a single differentiable proxy involving hard assignment fractions and average router probabilities. ZXNAME0000XZ uses dynamic routing biases for its main batch-level balancing pressure.
zh: 后来的工作简化或取代了这些目标。 Switch 使用涉及硬分配分数和平均路由器概率的单个可微代理。 ZXNAME0000XZ 使用动态路由偏差作为主要的批次级平衡压力。
